explanation: The statement is about `ffIso`, a definition made in this library (the function-field isomorphism induced by an open immersion). It is the `U = ⊤` case of the library's own lemma `germ_ffIso_hom`. Mathlib has no `ffIso`; a grep for it in Mathlib gave no matches. I also searched Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry for `functionField` and found only the function-field basics: `FunctionField.lean`, `OrderOfVanishing.lean` and `RationalMap.lean`. None of them contains an iso of function fields along an open immersion or a germ-compatibility lemma for one. The content of the lemma lies in the library's own definition.
